cities.name: Mount Beauty
cities.tagline: Kiewa Valley town below Mount Bogong and the Falls Creek road
cities.general: Mount Beauty sits in the Kiewa Valley as the practical base for Mount Bogong, Falls Creek, and high-country walking in Alpine National Park.
activities: Climb Mount Bogong via Staircase Spur
tips: Book summer trailhead parking on weekends

cities.name: Harrietville
cities.tagline: Ovens Valley village at the foot of Mount Feathertop
cities.general: Harrietville is the trailhead village for Mount Feathertop, with the Bungalow Spur and Razorback approaches, gold-history streets, and a quiet alpine-valley setting.

cities.name: Thredbo
cities.tagline: Snowy Mountains village for Kosciuszko walks and ski-season access
cities.general: Thredbo is the main Kosciuszko resort village, with summer summit walks from the Kosciuszko Express chairlift and winter ski access into Australia's highest country.
tips: Chairlift hours define the easiest summit start

cities.name: Falls Creek
cities.tagline: High-plains village above the Kiewa Valley and Bogong High Plains
cities.general: Falls Creek sits on the Bogong High Plains with summer wildflower walks, hut country, and winter ski fields above Mount Beauty.

cities.name: Pomona
cities.tagline: Noosa hinterland town below Mount Cooroora
cities.general: Pomona is a small Noosa hinterland town with a heritage main street and the steep Mount Cooroora summit walk rising directly above the village.
activities: Continue to Noosa or Kin Kin
tips: The Cooroora climb is steep and rocky

cities.name: Paluma
cities.tagline: Wet-tropics village on the Mount Spec range above Townsville
cities.general: Paluma is a tiny rainforest village on the Paluma Range, with cloud-forest walks, dams, and lookouts back to the Coral Sea.
tips: The range road is winding and wet
Carry a jacket; it is cooler than the coast

cities.name: Rathdowney
cities.tagline: Scenic Rim village on the road to Mount Barney
cities.general: Rathdowney is the last service village before Mount Barney National Park, with paddocks, a small main street, and access to South East Queensland's biggest walk-up peak.
activities: Continue to Boonah or the border ranges
tips: Start Barney walks before dawn in summer
Phone coverage drops in the park
Carry more water than you expect

cities.name: Porepunkah
cities.tagline: Ovens River village at the Mount Buffalo road junction
cities.general: Porepunkah sits where the Mount Buffalo road leaves the Ovens Valley, with river camping, Bright-cycle-path access, and the climb onto the Buffalo plateau.
tips: The plateau road is steep and can ice
Book plateau walks around weather windows

cities.name: Wilpena Pound
cities.tagline: Ikara-Flinders Ranges resort and trailhead below St Mary Peak
cities.general: Wilpena Pound is the main trailhead inside Ikara-Flinders Ranges National Park, with hut-country walks and the St Mary Peak circuit around the pound rim.

parks.name: Glass House Mountains National Park
parks.tagline: Volcanic plugs and short summit walks on the Sunshine Coast hinterland
parks.summary: Glass House Mountains National Park protects the rhyolite plugs of Beerwah, Tibrogargan, Ngungun, and neighbouring peaks, with steep summit scrambles and easier base walks.

parks.name: Kondalilla National Park
parks.tagline: Blackall Range rainforest and Kondalilla Falls
parks.summary: Kondalilla National Park drops from the Blackall Range escarpment through subtropical rainforest to Kondalilla Falls and rock pools.

parks.name: Mapleton National Park
parks.tagline: Blackall Range forest, lookouts, and waterfall walks above Nambour
parks.summary: Mapleton National Park covers escarpment forest on the Blackall Range, with Mapleton Falls, day walks, and views over the Sunshine Coast.

parks.name: Mount Barney National Park
parks.tagline: South East Queensland's biggest walk-up mountain massif
parks.summary: Mount Barney National Park protects granite peaks on the Scenic Rim, with steep routes to Barney, Lindesay, and Maroon and a remote border-range setting.

parks.name: Wooroonooran National Park
parks.tagline: Wet Tropics rainforest around Bartle Frere and Bellenden Ker
parks.summary: Wooroonooran National Park holds Queensland's two highest peaks, with rainforest, waterfalls, and the long Bartle Frere summit climb from the west or east.

parks.name: Mount Buffalo National Park
parks.tagline: Granite plateau of gorges, snow gums, and Horn walk lookouts
parks.summary: Mount Buffalo National Park is a granite plateau above the Ovens Valley, with The Horn, gorge lookouts, lakes, and winter snow on a short drive from Bright.

parks.name: Mount Kaputar National Park
parks.tagline: Nandewar Range volcanic high country above Narrabri
parks.summary: Mount Kaputar National Park rises from the north-west slopes as a cool volcanic range, with lookouts, snow gums, and the Mount Kaputar summit walk.

parks.name: Mount Remarkable National Park
parks.tagline: Southern Flinders peak and Alligator Gorge
parks.summary: Mount Remarkable National Park covers the southern Flinders Ranges around Melrose and Alligator Gorge, with a steep summit walk and red-rock gorge trails.

parks.name: Mount Augustus National Park
parks.tagline: One of the world's largest monoclines, with a long summit loop
parks.summary: Mount Augustus National Park protects Burringurrah, a vast sandstone monocline in the Gascoyne, with a long hot summit walk and gorge side trips.

parks.name: Hartz Mountains National Park
parks.tagline: Tasmanian dolerite peaks and tarns above the Huon
parks.summary: Hartz Mountains National Park is a compact alpine park south of Hobart, with boardwalks to lookouts and a rocky climb to Hartz Peak.

parks.name: Ben Lomond National Park
parks.tagline: Dolerite plateau and Tasmania's main ski field
parks.summary: Ben Lomond National Park is a high dolerite plateau in north-east Tasmania, with Jacobs Ladder, winter skiing, and summer plateau walks.

parks.name: Mount Coolum National Park
parks.tagline: Coastal volcanic plug above the Sunshine Coast beach strip
parks.summary: Mount Coolum National Park is a small reserve around the rhyolite plug of Mount Coolum, with a steep summit track and wide coastal views.

parks.name: D'Aguilar National Park
parks.tagline: Forest ranges immediately west of Brisbane
parks.summary: D'Aguilar National Park covers the forested ranges west of Brisbane, including Mount Glorious, Mount Nebo, and walks above the city catchment.

parks.name: Wollumbin National Park
parks.tagline: Sacred volcanic plug and steep rainforest summit track
parks.summary: Wollumbin National Park protects the volcanic plug of Wollumbin / Mount Warning, with a steep rainforest climb and cultural access rules.

parks.name: Mount Canobolas State Conservation Area
parks.tagline: Extinct volcano and highest point on the central tablelands
parks.summary: Mount Canobolas is an extinct volcano west of Orange, with a short summit walk, lookouts, and cool-climate forest above the orchards.

hikes.name: Mount Ngungun Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Short steep climb to the best Glass House Mountains viewpoint
hikes.summary: The Mount Ngungun Summit Walk is the most accessible Glass House Mountains climb, rising through woodland to a rocky summit with views of Beerwah, Tibrogargan, and Coonowrin.
tips: Carry water; the climb is short but steep
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed Ngungun car park off Fullertons Road.

hikes.name: Mount Tibrogargan Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Exposed volcanic-plug scramble above Beerwah township
hikes.summary: The Tibrogargan Summit Walk climbs steep rock on the crouching-gorilla plug, with exposure, loose sections, and wide hinterland views.
tips: Avoid in rain or high wind
Check current park access before climbing
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Tibrogargan day-use area off Marshs Road.

hikes.name: Mount Beerwah Walk
hikes.tagline: Steep climb of the highest Glass House Mountains plug
hikes.summary: The Mount Beerwah Walk is a steep volcanic-plug climb from the western trailhead, with rock slabs, exposure, and summit views across the Sunshine Coast hinterland.
tips: Confirm the track is open; access has been restricted at times
Rock slabs are dangerous when wet
This is a serious short climb, not a stroll
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Mount Beerwah car park west of the peak if the summit route is open.

hikes.name: Tibrogargan Circuit
hikes.tagline: Easy woodland loop around the base of Mount Tibrogargan
hikes.summary: The Tibrogargan Circuit is a mostly easy loop around the base of the plug, with changing views of the cliff faces and nearby peaks.
tips: Good alternative if the summit is closed or too exposed
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Tibrogargan day-use area and follow the signed circuit.

hikes.name: Kondalilla Falls Circuit
hikes.tagline: Steep rainforest descent to the waterfall and swimming hole
hikes.summary: The Kondalilla Falls Circuit drops from the Blackall Range picnic area through rainforest to the waterfall and rock pools, then climbs back to the escarpment.
tips: Rocks around the pool are slippery
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Kondalilla National Park picnic area near Montville.

hikes.name: Mount Coolum Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Steep coastal-plug climb above Coolum Beach
hikes.summary: The Mount Coolum Summit Walk climbs the rhyolite plug from Tanah Street West, with a short, steep pad to a broad summit and views along the Sunshine Coast.
tips: Start early; the slope has little shade
Parking on Tanah Street fills quickly
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed trailhead on Tanah Street West, Mount Coolum.

hikes.name: Mount Tinbeerwah Lookout Walk
hikes.tagline: Short hinterland climb to a Noosa-coast lookout
hikes.summary: The Mount Tinbeerwah walk climbs from the sealed lookout road to a summit platform with views over lakes, forest, and the Noosa coast.
tips: The last rock steps are steep
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Mount Tinbeerwah car park off Tinbeerwah Road.

hikes.name: Mount Cooroora Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Steep rocky climb from Pomona to the Cooroora plug
hikes.summary: The Mount Cooroora Summit Walk rises directly from Pomona through woodland and rock to a sharp volcanic summit above the Noosa hinterland.
tips: A serious short climb with exposure
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed trailhead on Reserve Street in Pomona.

hikes.name: Mount Barney South Ridge
hikes.tagline: Classic steep route to South East Queensland's biggest peak
hikes.summary: The South Ridge route is the usual walkers' line on Mount Barney, climbing from Yellow Pinch through open forest and steep rock to East Peak.
tips: The descent is hard on knees and navigation
hikes.start_instructions: Start from Yellow Pinch car park and follow the South Ridge / Peasants Ridge signs.

hikes.name: Bartle Frere Western Summit Track
hikes.tagline: Queensland's highest mountain through Wet Tropics rainforest
hikes.summary: The western Bartle Frere track climbs from Josephine Falls / Broken Nose country through rainforest, boulders, and cloud forest to Queensland's highest summit.
tips: This is a long, wet, and serious day
Carry a map; the top can be socked in
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the western Bartle Frere trailhead near Josephine Falls / Broken Nose access.

hikes.name: Walshs Pyramid Walk
hikes.tagline: Steep standalone climb south of Cairns
hikes.summary: Walshs Pyramid is a relentless grassy and rocky climb from Gordonvale's southern flats to a sharp summit with Wet Tropics and coast views.
tips: Carry more water than the distance suggests
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed car park on the Gordonvale–Gillies side of the peak.

hikes.name: Mount Coot-tha Summit Track
hikes.tagline: Brisbane lookout mountain from the botanic gardens
hikes.summary: The Mount Coot-tha tracks climb from the botanic gardens and JC Slaughter Falls to the summit lookout above Brisbane.
tips: The summit lookout has traffic; the tracks are quieter
hikes.start_instructions: Start from JC Slaughter Falls or the botanic gardens and follow summit-track signs.

hikes.name: Mount Feathertop via Bungalow Spur
hikes.tagline: Victoria's classic hut-and-summit climb from Harrietville
hikes.summary: Bungalow Spur is the standard walkers' route to Mount Feathertop, climbing from Harrietville through forest to Federation Hut and the exposed summit ridge.
tips: The summit ridge is dangerous in high wind or snow
Carry an emergency layer even in summer
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Feathertop Track car park on Feathertop Track, Harrietville.

hikes.name: Mount Bogong via Staircase Spur
hikes.tagline: Victoria's highest mountain from Mountain Creek
hikes.summary: Staircase Spur is the classic Mount Bogong route, climbing from Mountain Creek through mountain ash to Bivouac Hut and the exposed high plains summit.
tips: Alpine weather kills; turn back if it closes in
Snow and ice linger into spring
hikes.start_instructions: Start from Mountain Creek campground and follow Staircase Spur signs.

hikes.name: The Horn Walk Mount Buffalo
hikes.tagline: Short granite climb to the highest point on Mount Buffalo
hikes.summary: The Horn Walk crosses snow-gum woodland and granite slabs to the highest point of the Mount Buffalo plateau, with views over the Ovens Valley.
tips: The last slabs are exposed in wind
Combine with the Gorge and Lake Catani
hikes.start_instructions: Drive the plateau road to The Horn car park and take the signed walk.

hikes.name: Mount Macedon Memorial Cross Walk
hikes.tagline: Forest walk to the Memorial Cross above the Macedon Ranges
hikes.summary: The Mount Macedon walk climbs through cool forest to the Memorial Cross and lookout, with views across the volcanic plains toward Melbourne.
tips: The cross precinct can be busy on weekends
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed Macedon Ranges walks near the Memorial Cross road.

hikes.name: Mount William Walk
hikes.tagline: Highest Grampians peak from the sealed summit road
hikes.summary: The Mount William walk uses the sealed access road and a short summit pad to the highest peak in Gariwerd / the Grampians, with wide western-district views.
tips: The top is cold and windy
The road is steep; walkers share it with cars
hikes.start_instructions: Drive the Mount William Road to the upper car park and walk the summit track.

hikes.name: Didthul / Pigeon House Mountain Walk
hikes.tagline: Sandstone peak with ladders to a Morton National Park summit
hikes.summary: The Didthul walk climbs from Yadboro country through forest and sandstone to steel ladders and a small summit with coast and Budawang views.
tips: Start early; the last kilometres of road are unsealed
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Pigeon House Mountain car park off Yadboro Road.

hikes.name: Mount Solitary Walk
hikes.tagline: Blue Mountains ridge above the Jamison Valley
hikes.summary: The Mount Solitary walk drops from the Golden Stairs or Katoomba cliffs, crosses the Ruined Castle saddle, and climbs the solitary ridge above the valley floor.
tips: This is a long, steep day
Carry a light; the descent is slow
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Golden Stairs car park on Glenraphael Drive, Katoomba.

hikes.name: Mount Kaputar Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Short high-country walk to the Nandewar Range summit
hikes.summary: The Mount Kaputar summit walk is a short high-plateau stroll from the road to the lookout on the Nandewar Range above Narrabri.
tips: The access road is long and winding
It can be cold even in summer
hikes.start_instructions: Drive the Mount Kaputar road to the summit car park.

hikes.name: St Mary Peak Circuit
hikes.tagline: Highest walk in Ikara / Wilpena Pound
hikes.summary: The St Mary Peak circuit climbs from Wilpena through Tanderra Saddle to Ngarri Mudlanha, then returns around the pound rim with huge Flinders views.
tips: The outer loop is long and exposed
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Wilpena visitor centre and follow Tanderra Saddle / St Mary Peak signs.

hikes.name: Mount Lofty Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Adelaide Hills climb from Waterfall Gully to the summit lookout
hikes.summary: The Waterfall Gully to Mount Lofty walk is Adelaide's staple mountain path, climbing beside First Falls and through stringybark forest to the summit lookout.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from Waterfall Gully car park and follow the Mount Lofty Summit track.

hikes.name: Mount Remarkable Summit Hike
hikes.tagline: Southern Flinders climb from Melrose
hikes.summary: The Mount Remarkable summit hike climbs from Melrose through forest and steep ridgeline to the highest point of the southern Flinders.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed trailhead in Melrose.

hikes.name: Toolbrunup Peak Walk
hikes.tagline: Steep Stirling Range scramble near Bluff Knoll
hikes.summary: Toolbrunup is a steep, rocky Stirling Range climb with loose gullies and a sharp summit, shorter than Bluff Knoll but more technical.
tips: Avoid in wet or high wind
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Toolbrunup car park on Stirling Range Drive.

hikes.name: Castle Rock and Granite Skywalk
hikes.tagline: Granite castle and skywalk in the Porongurup Range
hikes.summary: The Castle Rock walk climbs through karri and granite to the Granite Skywalk platform on the Porongurup Range east of Albany.
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Castle Rock car park in Porongurup National Park.

hikes.name: Mount Augustus Summit Loop
hikes.tagline: Long hot climb of Burringurrah in the Gascoyne
hikes.summary: The Mount Augustus summit loop is a long exposed walk up the sandstone monocline, with gorge views and a huge Gascoyne horizon.
tips: Walk in the cooler months only
Carry more water than you think you need
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the signed summit car park inside Mount Augustus National Park.

hikes.name: Mount Sonder Lookout Walk
hikes.tagline: Larapinta western high point above the Redbank valley
hikes.summary: The Mount Sonder walk climbs from Redbank Gorge along the Larapinta's last ridge to Rwetyepme, often done for sunrise over the West MacDonnells.
tips: Start in the dark for sunrise
hikes.start_instructions: Start from Redbank Gorge car park at the western end of the Larapinta Trail.

hikes.name: Frenchmans Cap Track
hikes.tagline: Western Tasmania quartzite dome from Lake Tahune
hikes.summary: The Frenchmans Cap Track crosses the Loddon Plains and climbs to Lake Tahune hut, then a steep quartzite pad to one of Tasmania's most striking summits.
tips: The Loddon can be a mud slog
Book or carry a tent for Tahune
The summit is dangerous in ice and high wind
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Frenchmans Cap trackhead on the Lyell Highway west of Derwent Bridge.

hikes.name: Mount Ossa Side Trip
hikes.tagline: Tasmania's highest mountain from Pelion Gap
hikes.summary: The Mount Ossa side trip leaves the Overland Track at Pelion Gap and climbs dolerite toward Tasmania's highest summit, often combined with Pelion West views.
tips: This is a side trip, not a shortcut
hikes.start_instructions: Leave the Overland Track at Pelion Gap and follow the Mount Ossa pad.

hikes.name: Hartz Peak Walk
hikes.tagline: Dolerite summit above Hartz Lake in southern Tasmania
hikes.summary: The Hartz Peak walk follows boardwalk and alpine pad from the Hartz Mountains car park past lookouts and Lake Esperance to the rocky summit.
tips: Carry a jacket even in summer
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the Hartz Mountains National Park car park south of Geeveston.

hikes.name: Cradle Mountain Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Dolerite scramble from Dove Lake to the Cradle summit
hikes.summary: The Cradle Mountain summit walk leaves the Dove Lake circuit, climbs past Lake Wilks and the Face Track, and finishes on exposed dolerite to the summit.
tips: Turn back if the top is in cloud or ice
Start early from the Dove Lake shuttle
This is a scramble, not a staircase
hikes.start_instructions: Take the Dove Lake shuttle and follow Face Track / summit signs.

hikes.name: kunanyi / Mount Wellington Organ Pipes Walk
hikes.tagline: Alpine pad beneath the Organ Pipes above Hobart
hikes.summary: The Organ Pipes Walk traverses the dolerite columns on kunanyi / Mount Wellington, linking the Pinnacle area with Lost World and city views.
tips: Weather can be wintery in any month
Carry a layer even if Hobart is warm
hikes.start_instructions: Start from The Springs or the Pinnacle and follow Organ Pipes Track signs.

hikes.name: Mount Canobolas Summit Walk
hikes.tagline: Short volcanic summit above Orange
hikes.summary: The Mount Canobolas walk is a short climb to the highest point of the central tablelands, with lookouts over Orange and the western slopes.
tips: It can be cold and windy
hikes.start_instructions: Start from the picnic area on Mount Canobolas Road.

hikes.name: Breadknife and Grand High Tops Walk
hikes.tagline: Warrumbungle circuit to the rhyolite Breadknife
hikes.summary: The Grand High Tops walk climbs from Pincham through forest and volcanic walls to the Breadknife and ridge lookouts in Warrumbungle National Park.
tips: Carry water; the tops are exposed
hikes.start_instructions: Start from Pincham car park in Warrumbungle National Park.
